captured_from.pattern_description: The execution successfully resolved 3 merge conflicts during rebase against a remote commit introduced by a merged PR (#2). This rebase-with-conflict-resolution pattern during /ship should be documented as an expected path — the ship skill handled it gracefully in 25 turns, but there is no explicit guidance in the skill for conflict resolution strategy (manual vs. ours/theirs heuristics). Capturing this pattern would reduce future turn count.
